phenomenon_scale.note: 63 µm is the campaign detail-scale label of 6.33e-05 m. It is the wavelength at which k_c is fixed, not a thin-section measurement.

paleobiology.locality: Mistaken Point assemblage, Avalon Zone, Newfoundland

scale_neighbor.relation: organ-scale Turing module (same organism, coarser wavelength)
scale_neighbor.what_changes: 51 detail-scale wavelengths of 6.33e-05 m fit inside one 3.275 mm module and 52 do not. The 63 µm field is the branchlet/ocellus repeat; the 3.275 mm field is one primary module. Kinetics below are the detail-scale regime and are not the slot-1251 parameters.

equations.activator: du/dt = D_u ∇²u + a - u + u² v
equations.steady_state: u0 = a + b, v0 = b / (a + b)²
equations.dispersion: det(J - k² D) = D_u D_v k⁴ - (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) k² + (f_u g_v - f_v g_u)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c² = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.boundary_conditions: periodic on a rectangular patch of the rangeomorph surface; no-flux is not used
turing_conditions: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)² > 4 D_u D_v det(J)

parameters.length_unit: grid spacing dx fixed so analytical λ_c = 6.33e-05 m
parameters.time_unit: one Schnakenberg reaction time, mapped to 1 s when a physical diffusivity is quoted

empirical_claims.statement: Fractofusus misrai is a fusiform rangeomorph from the Mistaken Point assemblage, endemic to Newfoundland Avalonia, in communities below the photic zone during the mid-Ediacaran (ca. 575–560 Ma).
Rangeomorph fronds have a fractal body plan of self-similar, axial, apical, alternate branching that increases surface area, consistent with osmotrophy.
Fractofusus on Mistaken Point bedding planes shows recurrent clusters produced by multigenerational stolon-like asexual reproduction, interspersed with dispersal by waterborne propagules.
A homogeneous reaction-diffusion state can be unstable to a finite band of wavenumbers, selecting a stationary wavelength λ_c = 2π/k_c.
The detail-scale wavelength evaluated here is 63 µm (6.33e-05 m) at 565 Ma. No published Fractofusus thin section reports that pigment spacing.
